offering_description.value: Designs and manufactures centrifugal, self-priming, submersible and positive displacement pumps and pump systems for water, wastewater, fire protection, construction, petroleum, industrial and agricultural customers. Sells through distributors, OEM accounts and direct sales.

primary_products.value: self-priming centrifugal pumps; submersible pumps; positive displacement pumps; bypass pump systems; fire pump packages

primary_services.value: aftermarket parts supply; pump repair; engineered pump system design

customer_segment.value: B2B: contractors, OEMs, distributors, industrial plants, agricultural and petroleum operators; B2G: municipal water and wastewater utilities, military and government agencies

end_markets.value: water and wastewater; construction; fire protection; petroleum; industrial; agriculture; defense

revenue_model.value: product sales: pumps and pump packages sold to distributors, OEMs and end users; project or contract: engineered pump systems and government or military contracts

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: builds pumps from castings, motors and components, sold to distributors, OEMs and utilities

geography_served.value: global: North America, Europe, and export sales to customers in many other countries

specialization.value: niche specialist: pumps only, across several pump types and end markets

distribution_channels.value: distributors / dealers: independent pump and industrial distributors; direct sales: OEM accounts and large municipal or government buyers; agents / brokers: independent sales representatives in regional markets
distribution_channels.category: distributors / dealers; direct sales; agents / brokers

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: product certifications such as NSF/ANSI for drinking water and UL/FM for fire pumps, environmental and safety rules
